Keys: spawners[0].waves[] {night, warningText, difficultyMulti, totals{enemies,baseHp,flying,ranged,boss,byLine,spawnSpanSeconds}, spawns[] {enemy,count,elite,delay,interval,goldCoins,spawnLine,spawnCenter}}; spawnLines[] {name, points[] (world XYZ polyline), center, length, canSpawnFlying/SmallGround/BigGround, sharedPaths}; buildSlots[] {id,name,building,pos[x,y,z],yawDeg,interactorPos,activator{building,level},startDeactivated,levels[]{cost,coreCost,tooltip,branches[]{choice.name,goldIncome,hpChange,activates[] (units/towers with hp/range/dps/speed)}},unitProducer{respawnSecondsByLevel,unitTypes}}; shrines[] {pos,maxXp,collectionRange}; castle[]{pos}; heroes[]{movement speeds, interactionRadius=3.0, coinMagnetRadius=7.0}; enemies{} per-prefab stats; nightCall[]; autoDayNight[].

- Spawn lines are POLYLINES of child transforms (Spawn.cs:274-297); enemies spawn at random points along them. Line 'center' is the mean of its points.

HIGH-IMPACT FINDING (affects 'stands still at nightfall'): NO Nighthorn object exists in ANY asset file (scanned level0-40, sharedassets*, resources, ggm): so Bot's HasHorn/StartNight-via-horn branch can never fire in this build. Night starts by (a) the player HOLDING the Rewired action "Call Night" for NightCall.nightCallTime (= 2.0 s in Nordfels/Durststein/Frostsee...) — NightCall.cs:68-90 — allowed only when PlayerInteraction.IsFreeToCallNight (PlayerInteraction.cs:77-87): !PlayerFrozen AND focussedInteractor == null (i.e. hero NOT within interaction range of any building interactor — radius 3.0) AND castle exists AND TutorialManager.AllowStartingTheNight AND !MatchOver AND state InMatch, and only when !DayNightCycle.AutomatedDaytime; or (b) AutoDayNight (some mini modes: e.g. Durststein Speedrun dayLength=20 s); night ends automatically when no spawning + 0 enemies (DayNightCycle.cs:~104), dawn after sunriseTime, and Wavenumber >= waves.Count-1 => AfterMatchVictory (DayNightCycle.cs:~200). Your fallback DayNightCycle.SwitchToNight() has the same effect as a completed NightCall fill, but the LEGIT path = walk away from every interactor, then hold "Call Night" 2 s (a Harmony postfix on Rewired Player.GetButton("Call Night") is the natural hook).
